name: resistance band clam
description: A side-lying clam with a band around the thighs that strengthens the outer hip and glutes.
instructions: Lie on your side with a loop band just above your knees and knees bent.
Stack your hips and keep your feet together.
Open the top knee away from the bottom one like a clam.
Keep your pelvis still and do not roll backward.
Complete the reps, then switch sides.
